method: Matching 10 MHz blocking/manual/repeat-1 50-route captures. Warm-up excluded; median of 25 per-channel standard deviations in each complete 20 ms window per array. Nominal 2.5 V/4096 conversion; no filtering/interpolation.

hardware_state: Both sensor strips remain unplugged; board analog supply remains USB-derived. User reconnected laptop charger before return capture.
limitations: Three separate short captures; earlier charger reference preceded battery/return captures. No simultaneous analog-rail, ground, USB-traffic, or op-amp-output measurement. Correlation does not identify electrical mechanism.
